patch_description: This program is a crossover between two high-performing candidate ansatze. It preserves the original training, data, and evaluation pipeline while improving the ansatz block by combining symmetry-aware parameter sharing, a fixed CZ backbone for stable short-range entanglement, shared controlled-RZ (CRZ) grid couplings, explicit three-qubit ZZZ motifs aligned with tic-tac-toe winning lines, and compressed CCRZ higher-order interactions. The block reduces redundant parameters via symmetry grouping (corners/edges/center) and reuses center-focused CCRZ weights to keep parameter count efficient while preserving expressive high-order motifs. The layout is ordered to encourage local entanglement then line-sensitive three-body motifs and finishes with compact post-phase rotations plus a small RX on the center to tune draw sensitivity. The EVOLVE-BLOCK markers remain intact; only ANSATZ_SPEC is changed.
